'''Coming of Age ''' is the 36th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on June 29, 2018. The set consists of 29 cards. This set was part of the ''The Next Generation Block'' that consisted of cards from [[The Next Generation]], [[The Next Generation: Supplemental]], [[Engage]], [[The Sky's the Limit]], [[Coming of Age (expansion)|Coming of Age]], and [[Q Who? (expansion)|Q Who?]] virtual expansions.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*4 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*22 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (1 Cardassian, 3 Federation, 5 Ferengi, 5 Klingon, 8 Non-Aligned, and 4 Romulan)
*1 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Ferengi)

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Starter Decks==
Four starter decks were published with this expansion. These were updated versions of the starter decks published with [[The Next Generation]] and [[Engage]] expansion sets. The links redirect to pdf files.

*[https://www.trekcc.org/1e/expansions/comingofage/TNG_Starter_Deck_FED_v2.pdf Federation Starter Deck version 2.0]
*[https://www.trekcc.org/1e/expansions/comingofage/TNG_Starter_Deck_FER_v2.pdf Ferengi Starter Deck version 2.0]
*[https://www.trekcc.org/1e/expansions/comingofage/TNG_Starter_Deck_KLG_v2.pdf Klingon Starter Deck version 2.0]
